name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Dev-Browser: Enhance AI Agents with Web Browsing
short_description: The dev-browser skill helps AI agents with web browsing capabilities, enabling them to gather real-time information and interact with web content effectively. Built with TypeScript and leveraging Playwright, this skill enhances the functionality of AI agents in various applications.
author: SawyerHood

sections.overview:
dev-browser is a TypeScript-based skill that equips AI agents with web browsing capabilities powered by Playwright. It allows agents to access real-time information from the internet and interact with web content programmatically. The skill integrates with AI development tools like Claude Code and Cursor, enabling agents to navigate websites, extract data, and perform web interactions as part of automated workflows. This makes it useful for agents that need to research information, monitor web content, or automate browser-based tasks. With support for multiple platforms and active maintenance, dev-browser provides a reliable foundation for adding web navigation to AI agent applications.
Automate the retrieval of real-time stock prices for financial analysis.
Conduct automated web scraping to gather competitor pricing data.
Interactively test user flows on web applications to identify bugs.
Gather customer feedback by dynamically engaging with web forms.
sections.usage:
```
Use the dev-browser skill to navigate to [WEBSITE_URL] and gather information about [TOPIC]. Specifically, look for [SPECIFIC_DATA_POINTS] and summarize the findings in a structured format. Ensure the data is up-to-date and relevant to [INDUSTRY_OR_FIELD].
```

```
3. **Join Process**: To join the waitlist, users need to provide their email address and press Enter to continue. Once submitted, they will receive a confirmation message indicating that they will be contacted soon.
4. **Additional Information**: The website also mentions that Type is actively working on new features and improvements, and joining the waitlist ensures users will be among the first to experience these updates.

This information is relevant to the tech industry, particularly for teams looking to enhance their collaborative workflows and productivity.
```
